args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 failed health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with error rate 0.18. Rolled back to previous healthy production release v2.3.0 in all regions.

trace.final:
Done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with health checks failing and an 18% error rate. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled checkout-api back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. The rollback was verified — all three regions now run v2.3.0, health checks pass, and the error rate dropped to 0.2%.

3. **Opened incident**: Created **SEV2 incident INC-0001** for checkout-api describing the failure and the rollback, which paged the on-call engineer.

Note: v2.3.1 remains the latest release and should be investigated before any re-deploy attempt.
